## Course Context

- Instructor: Simon D. Halliday.
- Course code: ECO250.
- Main text: [*Microeconomics: Competition, Conflict, and Coordination*](../microeconomics/) by Samuel Bowles and Simon D. Halliday.

## Worksheets

I used worksheets for in-class exercises for a variety of units in the book,
mainly Units 2 through 9. You can download the original zipped collection
[here](https://drive.google.com/open?id=1urlQl9gjEcig58TERQabNAIHsJUeCsSK).
